fitsCorruptOrEmpty: This FITS file is empty or corrupted and cannot be displayed.

serverCodes.APPLY_FAILED: Could not queue the update for install.
serverCodes.BAD_FOV: Enter a field of view above 0 degrees.
serverCodes.CODE_INVALID: That code is invalid or has expired.
serverCodes.DEVICE_NAME_REQUIRED: Give the device a name first.
serverCodes.DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: That device is no longer paired. Reload the list and try again.
serverCodes.EXPIRED: Download link has expired or does not exist
serverCodes.INVALID_COORDS: Valid latitude (-90 to 90) and longitude (-180 to 180) required
serverCodes.INVALID_LOCATE_INPUT: Provide a folder name and a non-empty file sample.
serverCodes.INVALID_NETWORK_CONFIG: Enter a server address and share name.
serverCodes.INVALID_OBJECT_ID: That object is not in your library. Open it from the Library page, or run a sync to bring it back.
serverCodes.INVALID_PARAMS: Set your location first, in Settings → Sky.
serverCodes.LAST_SITE: Cannot delete the last observing site. Add another first.
serverCodes.LAST_TRANSPORT: Cannot delete the last transport on a telescope. Add another first, or archive the telescope.
serverCodes.LIBRARY_BUSY: The library is being moved. Wait for that to finish first.
serverCodes.LIBRARY_MIGRATING: The library is being moved to a new location. Try again once the move finishes.
serverCodes.MAINTENANCE_DISABLED: Nightly maintenance is turned off. Turn it on to run it now.
serverCodes.MISSING_DEVICE_CODE: That pairing link is incomplete. Scan the QR code again.
serverCodes.MISSING_PATHS: Choose at least one file first.
serverCodes.NETWORK_TO_NETWORK_UNSUPPORTED: Moving directly from one network share to another is not supported on macOS. Move the library to a local folder first, then to the new share.
serverCodes.NOT_STAGED: The update is still downloading. Try again shortly.
serverCodes.NO_LAN_ADDRESS: Could not determine a network address for this server. Connect the server to your network and try again.
serverCodes.NO_PLANNING_WINDOW: No sunset-to-sunrise planning window occurs for this location tonight
serverCodes.NO_THUMBNAIL: No thumbnail found in local library. Run a sync first.
serverCodes.NO_UPDATE: No update is available to apply.
serverCodes.QR_FAILED: Could not generate the QR code. Please try again.
serverCodes.REGISTRATION_CLOSED: Registration is closed. Ask an admin to create your account.
serverCodes.RESET_FAILED: The reset did not finish. Check the system log for the reason, then run it again.
serverCodes.SAME_TARGET: Source and destination telescopes must differ
serverCodes.SESSION_INVALIDATED: Session invalidated. Please log in again.
serverCodes.SETUP_REQUIRED: Create the first user account before performing write operations.
serverCodes.TMP_NOT_FOUND: Upload session not found. Please start over.
serverCodes.UNSUPPORTED_PLATFORM: Network share library locations are not supported on this platform.
serverCodes.ARCHIVE_DISABLED: The archive is turned off, so nothing was written or deleted. Turn it on in Settings, on the Archive tab.
serverCodes.ARCHIVE_RETENTION_DISABLED: Pruning is turned off, so nothing was deleted. Turn it on in the archive settings.
